title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC tip — if imputation is antecedent/immediate, that union is not its foundation
pass_a_gloss: Tip: Placeus grants natural union, but if the imputation meant is antecedent or immediate, that union is not its foundation—and he invites Garrigues to continue. Tip before the mortem Adami imputari exchange.
pass_b_english: PLAC. If the imputation is understood as antecedent or immediate, that union is not its foundation. But let him go on.
source_text: PLAC. Si imputatio intelligitur antecedens seu immediata, non est illius fundamentum unio illa. Sed pergat.

choices.choice: Antecedent/immediate imputation not founded on that union

notes: Cap. IX GAR Resp.1 densify section 610 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 347–348 tip).
